name: Andrzej Nowak
bio:
Andrzej's motorsport journey began in his youth, tinkering with go-karts in his father's workshop. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, channeling his passion into a formal education. After graduating, he joined a small engineering firm that supplied components to various racing teams. His sharp eye for detail and problem-solving skills quickly gained him recognition, leading to an opportunity with a Formula Ford team as a junior engineer. He spent several years refining his understanding of vehicle dynamics and performance optimization. 

Andrzej's approach as Technical Director is rooted in data-driven analysis and a relentless pursuit of marginal gains. He believes in empowering his team to explore innovative solutions while maintaining a strong focus on reliability and efficiency. He has a reputation for his meticulous nature and his ability to identify subtle performance bottlenecks. His time at Caterham Academy is driven by the desire to apply his extensive experience to develop young talent and guide them towards success in higher formulas. He hopes to build a championship-winning team by pushing boundaries and nurturing a culture of continuous improvement.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium build with a focused gaze, Andrzej's stern expression is softened by the crinkles around his eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down observations.
Insists on starting every meeting precisely on time, even if it means locking the door.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
